sam (AE): Heads up
cme demo blockedthey POSTed one JSON with ~9.5MB and got 413. Friday demo. Need quick options.
rita (SE): Do we have content-length + shape? Are they bundling examples client-side?
sam (AE): ~9.5MB, ~8k small examples in one array. They assumed large context is fine. Security: they don't allow presigned external uploads.
lucas (runtime): Hosted ingress default = 8MB. Logs: `ingress: reject: body_size=9.5MB > max_body=8MB`
rita (SE): Short-term choices: 1) client chunking + assemble on server with our SDK helper, 2) internal pointer (if they can host internally and we can fetch), 3) scoped temporary ingress bump for their org for the demo.
sam (AE): They refuse external presigns, so pointer to public S3 is out. Which option is fastest?
lucas (runtime): Fastest that requires no infra change: chunking + session state to avoid re-sending system prompt each chunk. Fast but needs client code change. Second-fastest: I can request EngInfra a scoped bump to 16MB for 72h but require Security signoff.
rita (SE): Cost note for customer: billing is per-token. N split calls that re-send the same long system prompt will multiply those system tokens. A single pointer-based single-call is cheapest for token count.
infra-bot: ticket INC-4102 created: "ingress bump request for acme-poc" assigned to eng-infra.
sam (AE): Can we get the temporary increase by EOD tomorrow? Demo Friday.
lucas (runtime): I'll escalate with infra + security and post updates here. Also prepping a tiny chunking sample and token-count example.
rita (SE): I'll send a 1-pager to the customer listing the three options, sample code, and a simple cost comparison.
sam (AE): Thanks all 
please update thread when ticket moves. :thumbsup:
